items.title: Home Depot (HD) Brings Magic Apron AI Assistant To All U.S. Stores
items.summary: Home Depot (NYSE:HD) has rolled out its Magic Apron AI shopping assistant across all U.S. stores. The Magic Apron tool offers real-time project guidance, product location, and expert advice through the Home Depot app and in store QR codes. Customers and associates can access multi language support and image recognition to help match projects with the right materials and tools. The nationwide deployment marks a wider use of artificial intelligence inside physical home improvement retail...

items.title: Tariffs Hurt Williams-Sonoma More Than the Housing Market
items.summary: Williams-Sonoma  stock dropped on Wednesday even though the home specialty retailer delivered a beat-and-raise quarter in tough times for housing.  The stock is up 25% this year, but down 11% from its all-time closing high of $251.78 on Aug. 7, according to Dow Jones Market Data.  While other retailers are logging tariff refunds, Williams-Sonoma is feeling a sting.
